name: Nextcloud AIO
description: Nextcloud All-in-One is the official Nextcloud deployment: one master container manages Nextcloud, database, Office, Talk and backups. This VM runs it on a Debian or Ubuntu cloud image with Docker.

notes.text: Nextcloud AIO needs a domain with a valid certificate and does not work on a bare IP. For a VM that works on an IP straight away, use the TurnKey-based nextcloud-vm instead.
Finish the setup at https://<VM-IP>:8080 with the AIO password: `docker exec nextcloud-aio-mastercontainer grep password /mnt/docker-aio-config/data/configuration.json`
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
